entities.name: Emperor Jingzong of Tang
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Emperor Jingzong of Tang, personal name Li Zhan, was an emperor of China's Tang dynasty. He reigned from 824 to 827. Emperor Jingzong was the eldest son of Emperor Muzong and elder brother of the later Emperor Wenzong and Emperor Wuzong.
